title: York Escape | KEY.co
description_expanded: York Escape in Watersound, FL, is the ultimate getaway for families, offering a blend of comfort and luxury. This three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bathroom vacation home features a spacious, open kitchen equipped with upgraded appliances, perfect for gathering and enjoying meals together. The large living area, with its 55" TV, provides a cozy spot for relaxation and entertainment. The master bedroom boasts a king bed and en suite bathroom with a double vanity and shower, while the second bedroom also has a king bed, and the third bedroom is ideal for kids with its full/full bunk bed. Additional conveniences include a half bathroom on the main level, a full-size washer and dryer, and a back deck with seating. Located in the popular Prominence community on 30A, York Escape offers access to fantastic amenities including two resort-style pools, expansive green spaces, and a 17-mile bike path perfect for exploring the area. The vibrant town center, just a short walk away, features The Big Chill, an entertainment hub with an outdoor 25 ft LED theater screen, restaurants, boutique shops, and a variety of family activities. Whether biking to the stunning white beaches or enjoying a concert, York Escape provides the perfect setting for an unforgettable vacation.
